subject.title: feishu_doc `create` action silently ignores `content` parameter — creates empty document

question: Should `feishu_doc` create support initial `content`, or should supplied `content` be rejected as unsupported?
rationale: Both fixes are mechanically small, but they define the Feishu tool contract and the create-then-write partial-failure behavior, so automation should not choose the product direction alone.

options.title: Support create-time content
options.body: Create the document, write supplied markdown through the existing write path, and preserve created metadata or roll back if the write step fails.

options.title: Reject content on create
options.body: Keep `create` title-only but fail clearly when callers supply `content`, with docs and tests that point users to create then write.

options.title: Review the linked candidate PR
options.body: Keep this issue open while the open fork PR is reviewed, repaired, merged, or explicitly replaced.

recommendation.title: Support create-time content
recommendation.body: Create the document, write supplied markdown through the existing write path, and preserve created metadata or roll back if the write step fails.

likelyOwner.reason: They have direct history in the Feishu create branch contract and were already pulled into the earlier create-with-content discussion.
